author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೀವಟಿಕೆಯಾಗಿ ನಡೆ ದಾರಿಕಾಣದ ಜನಕೆ
ಕಾವಳದ ತಂಪಂತೆ ಕಂಗೆಟ್ಟ ಮನಕೆ
ಕೇವಲದ ಮಾತಾಡಿ ಮನವ ನೋಯಿಸದಂತೆ
ಸಾವರಿಸಿ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Walk as a torch for those who cannot see the path,
as the cool of a grove to a troubled mind;
speaking only what is needed, without hurting hearts,
walk on with care, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Be a light for the lost and a comfort for the distressed. Speak gently and sparingly, so that no one is hurt by your words.
